name: net_progress_chest_goa
description: Native host GoA map chest opening, next-load client application and open animation, late-join latest snapshot, subsequent reload persistence, full personal snapshots and immediate-apply invariance. Fixture resets only bit409 in memory outside GoA, never saves. Native camera approach, reward gate, immediate opened153 and reloaded152 were calibrated live.

steps.expr: [peek('0x9ABC8F', 'u8', i) for i in range(3)]
all(peek('0x9ABC8F', 'u8', i) == (saved['original_chest_bytes'][i] & 253) for i in range(3))
steps.message: Fixture clear must preserve the other seven chest bits

steps.expr: all(any(c['flag'] == 409 and c['motionId'] == 151 and not c['openedBit'] for c in chests(i)) for i in range(2))
steps.message: Host and client must initialize the map chest closed

steps.expr: len(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] host (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 0)) > 0
int(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] host (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 0)[-1]["version"])

len(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] apply version=(?P<version>\\d+) spans=\\d+ bytes=\\d+ hash=[0-9A-Fa-f]+ personal_before=(?P<before>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_after=(?P<after>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_unchanged=(?P<unchanged>[01])', 1))
chests(0)
any(c['flag'] == 409 and c['motionId'] == 153 and c['openedBit'] for c in chests(0))
steps.message: Host native reaction must set flag409 and calibrated opened-animation153; reloaded clients use152

steps.expr: int(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] host (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 0)[-1]["version"]) > saved["version_before_open"]
int(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] host (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 0)[-1]["version"])

len(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] client (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 1)) > 0 and int(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] client (?:full|delta) version=(?P<version>\\d+)', 1)[-1]["version"]) >= saved["opened_version"]
chests(1)
any(c['flag'] == 409 and c['motionId'] == 152 and c['openedBit'] for c in chests(1))
steps.message: Client room init must show mirrored map chest open

steps.expr: len(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] apply version=(?P<version>\\d+) spans=\\d+ bytes=\\d+ hash=[0-9A-Fa-f]+ personal_before=(?P<before>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_after=(?P<after>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_unchanged=(?P<unchanged>[01])', 1)) > saved["apply_before_open"] and int(log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] apply version=(?P<version>\\d+) spans=\\d+ bytes=\\d+ hash=[0-9A-Fa-f]+ personal_before=(?P<before>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_after=(?P<after>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_unchanged=(?P<unchanged>[01])', 1)[-1]["version"]) >= saved["opened_version"]
steps.message: Client must apply a newer chest-containing progress version before room init

steps.expr: chests(2)
all(any(c['flag'] == 409 and c['motionId'] == 152 and c['openedBit'] for c in chests(i)) for i in range(3))
steps.message: Late join must receive current chest progress and initialize open

steps.expr: all(any(c['flag'] == 409 and c['motionId'] == 152 and c['openedBit'] for c in chests(i)) for i in range(3))
steps.message: Opened map chest must survive a subsequent all-peer reload

steps.expr: [log_matches('\\[progresssync\\] apply version=(?P<version>\\d+) spans=\\d+ bytes=\\d+ hash=[0-9A-Fa-f]+ personal_before=(?P<before>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_after=(?P<after>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) personal_unchanged=(?P<unchanged>[01])', i) for i in (1, 2)]
all(len(rows) > 0 and all(r['unchanged'] == '1' and r['before'] == r['after'] for r in rows) for rows in saved['personal_apply_evidence'])
steps.message: Every client apply must preserve personal bytes immediately around allowed writes

steps.expr: all(int(rows[-1]['version']) >= saved['opened_version'] for rows in saved['personal_apply_evidence'])
steps.message: Both clients must have applied the current opened-chest version
